$comment: Transcribed by hand from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFBP (AIP France, chart dated 2026-09-03): the text pages checked against the images of the pages.
Only what the chart states is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text; the reporting points, rules and notes were added by hand.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
The circuit side is not printed on this chart, so none is recorded.

The reporting points are in French: "location" is the name printed in the French column of the chart, copied and not translated, and "purpose" is written in French; a point whose French name could not be read has no "location". Only "spoken.en" is English: the name the English phraseology says over the radio.

The French of "circuit", "withAts" and "withoutAts" is in "fr": same tree as the English, text values only, written by hand from the French column of the chart where it was read, and translated from the English text otherwise; point and runway identifiers are repeated unchanged.
name: Pau-Pyrénées

source.extraction: manual, from the chart text and images
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text read by script for the notes; procedures written in French by hand

service.atsHours: civil: H24; military: Monday to Thursday 0700 to 1615, Friday 0700 to 1100, can be activated H24 (UTC in winter, local time minus 1 h in summer)

circuit.heightNote: runway pattern at 1600 ft AMSL minimum, lower altitude forbidden; maintain 1600 ft AMSL until established on final runway 13 or 31. Minimum flight altitude within the CTR other than in the pattern: 2500 ft AMSL

reportingPoints.name: N
reportingPoints.purpose: arrivées piste 13 par le nord : compte rendu ici à 1600 ft AMSL ; départs piste 31 vers le nord : virage vers ce point

reportingPoints.name: NE
reportingPoints.purpose: arrivées piste 31 par le nord : compte rendu ici à 2500 ft AMSL

reportingPoints.name: NA
reportingPoints.purpose: arrivées piste 31 par le nord : maintenir 2500 ft AMSL jusqu'ici, à l'ouest de la N134 pour éviter la DZ301 ; après NA, suivre les instructions de l'ATC

reportingPoints.name: S
reportingPoints.purpose: arrivées piste 31 par le sud : compte rendu ici à 2500 ft AMSL (à SE ou S)

reportingPoints.name: SA
reportingPoints.location: Rond point RN 117 / D509 / Silos de Lescar
reportingPoints.purpose: arrivées piste 31 par le sud : maintenir 2500 ft AMSL jusqu'ici ; après SA, suivre les instructions de l'ATC

reportingPoints.name: SE
reportingPoints.purpose: arrivées piste 31 par le sud : compte rendu ici à 2500 ft AMSL (à SE ou S)

reportingPoints.name: SW
reportingPoints.purpose: arrivées piste 13 par le sud : compte rendu ici à 2500 ft AMSL ; départs piste 31 vers le sud : virage vers ce point

arrivals.instruction: report at NE at 2500 ft AMSL and maintain 2500 ft AMSL until NA; stay west of the N134 until NA (water tower) to avoid DZ301; after NA comply with ATC instructions
report at SE or S at 2500 ft AMSL and maintain 2500 ft AMSL until SA; after SA comply with ATC instructions
report at N at 1600 ft AMSL and comply with ATC instructions
report at SW at 2500 ft AMSL and comply with ATC instructions

arrivals.note: overflight of the entry points, the VFR routes and the altitudes are mandatory unless otherwise cleared

departures.note: northern departures: at 500 ft AAL turn right towards N, climbing to 1600 ft AMSL
southern departures: at 500 ft AAL turn left towards SW, climbing to 2000 ft AMSL
northern departures: at 500 ft AAL turn left towards NA-NE, climbing to 1500 ft AMSL; after NA stay west of the N134 to avoid DZ301
southern departures: at 500 ft AAL turn right and climb to 2000 ft AMSL towards SA, then S or SE

radio.arrival: first contact with PYRENEES Info at least 5 minutes before overflying the entry points, awaiting clearance
radio.departure: state the destination and the wished exit point

notes: Aerodrome prohibited to gliders. Microlights are allowed with radio and transponder.
Non-commercial aviation: general aviation with PPR 48 HR mandatory.
Low-flying helicopters at 1500 ft AMSL maximum are present on all routes in the CTR (see the helicopter VAC chart).
Reduced spacing on the runway between single-engine VFR aircraft: minimum 1000 m.
Large bird presence from October to March.

Hot spots: HS 1, risk of runway incursion because of the short taxi distance from the parachuting boarding area to holding point S1; HS 2, risk of incursion on taxiways N and E from the end of the service road.

Special VFR meteorological minima, with IFR traffic: aeroplanes and helicopters visibility 3000 m, ceiling 1100 ft; without IFR traffic: aeroplanes visibility 1500 m, ceiling 600 ft; helicopters visibility 800 m, ceiling 600 ft. Special VFR routes are the same as the ones described.
Night VFR: radio contact with Pyrénées Information is compulsory 5 minutes before entering the controlled airspaces managed by Pau-Pyrénées.

Military: aircraft inbound to the 5th RHC or the 4th RHFS need prior permission from operations; radio contact with "Pau Opérations" is mandatory before entering the CTR, on 139.025, 55.65 or 379.225 MHz, and the landing clearance on the military area is given by "Pau Opérations".

Radio failure on arrival: squawk 7600; if the failure occurs before the CTR entry clearance, do not enter. Within the CTR before the pattern integration clearance, leave the CTR by the most suitable VFR route; after it, continue the landing as cleared.
Radio failure on departure: before take-off do not take off; after take-off squawk 7600 and turn around to return to the departure aerodrome.
Aerobatics nos. 6660, 6661 and 6666, AEM nos. 9016 and 9493 and parachuting nos. 301, 307, 355 and 373: see AIP ENR 5.5.

circuit.heightNote: circuit de piste à 1600 ft AMSL minimum, altitude inférieure interdite ; maintenir 1600 ft AMSL jusqu'à être établi en finale piste 13 ou 31. Altitude minimale de vol dans la CTR hors circuit : 2500 ft AMSL

arrivals.instruction: compte rendu à NE à 2500 ft AMSL et maintien de 2500 ft AMSL jusqu'à NA ; rester à l'ouest de la N134 jusqu'à NA (château d'eau) pour éviter la DZ301 ; après NA, suivre les instructions de l'ATC
compte rendu à SE ou S à 2500 ft AMSL et maintien de 2500 ft AMSL jusqu'à SA ; après SA, suivre les instructions de l'ATC
compte rendu à N à 1600 ft AMSL et suivre les instructions de l'ATC
compte rendu à SW à 2500 ft AMSL et suivre les instructions de l'ATC

arrivals.note: le survol des points d'entrée, les itinéraires VFR et les altitudes sont obligatoires sauf clairance contraire

departures.note: départs vers le nord : à 500 ft AAL, virer à droite vers N en montant à 1600 ft AMSL
départs vers le sud : à 500 ft AAL, virer à gauche vers SW en montant à 2000 ft AMSL
départs vers le nord : à 500 ft AAL, virer à gauche vers NA-NE en montant à 1500 ft AMSL ; après NA, rester à l'ouest de la N134 pour éviter la DZ301
départs vers le sud : à 500 ft AAL, virer à droite et monter à 2000 ft AMSL vers SA, puis S ou SE

radio.arrival: premier contact avec PYRENEES Info au moins 5 minutes avant le survol des points d'entrée, dans l'attente de la clairance
radio.departure: annoncer la destination et le point de sortie souhaité
